embeds.title: Previously reported products (still in the 90-day window)

fields.name: NVIDIA DLSS 4.5 Ray Reconstruction + Dynamic Multi Frame Generation in Control: Resonant
fields.value: NVIDIA — NVIDIA states Control: Resonant launches September 24, 2026 with the full DLSS 4.5 feature set — Ray Reconstruction, Dynamic Multi Frame Generation (up to 6X), and path-traced direct/indirect illumination and reflections — on GeForce RTX PCs/laptops and GeForce NOW, alongside a dedicated Game Ready Driver.

fields.name: Roblox Creator Roadmap 2026 Fall Update (AI texture generation, scene generation, motion matching, animation graph improvements, root motion, Avatar FACS upgrade, unified agentic permissions)
fields.value: Roblox — Roblox's Fall 2026 Creator Roadmap names upcoming AI texture generation, scene generation, motion matching, animation graph improvements, root motion, an Avatar FACS upgrade and unified agentic permissions.

fields.name: NVIDIA RTX Kit 2026.3 + ACE SDK update (RTX Character Rendering 1.4, RTX Neural Shading 1.4, RTX Mega Geometry 2.0, ACE Nemotron Speech 3.5 Streaming ASR, Qwen3 TTS)
fields.value: NVIDIA — NVIDIA's developer blog (dated Sept 22, 2026) bundles new ACE speech models (Nemotron Speech 3.5 streaming ASR, Qwen3 TTS), a round of RTX Kit 2026.3 component updates, and RTX Mega Geometry 2.0, which adds streaming of continuous level-of-detail clusters for high-density meshes.

fields.name: Roblox Studio — Tunable Collision Geometry (CollisionFidelity = Tunable)
fields.value: Roblox — Roblox added a CollisionPrecision slider under a new CollisionFidelity = Tunable option, letting developers fine-tune the performance/precision tradeoff of mesh collision on a per-part basis, plus improved collision visualization.

fields.name: HappyOyster Directing (happyoyster-1.0-directing) — world-model Open API
fields.value: Alibaba (ATH Innovation Business Group / Bailian) — borderline unit, flagged — Alibaba's Model Studio lists happyoyster-1.0-directing, a world-model Open API in invite-only testing (邀测).

fields.name: HappyOyster Acting (happyoyster-1.0-acting) — character role-play/interaction model Open API
fields.value: Alibaba (ATH Innovation Business Group / Bailian) — borderline unit, flagged — Alibaba's Model Studio lists happyoyster-1.0-acting, a character role-play/interaction model Open API in invite-only testing (邀测).

fields.name: HappyOyster 1.0 "Adventure" mode (happyoyster-1.0-adventure) via Alibaba Cloud Model Studio Open API
fields.value: Alibaba (ATH Innovation Business Group / Bailian) — Alibaba's Bailian (Model Studio) "newly released models" catalog added happyoyster-1.0-adventure, exposing the Adventure/world-exploration mode of the HappyOyster real-time interactive world model as a standalone, priced Open API endpoint, distinct from the consumer happyoyster.cn site and from the happyoyster-1.0-directing/-acting endpoints. Alibaba Cloud documentation lists per-call/per-second pricing (~$0.007067 per World Creation call, ~$0.028267 per second of World Experience at 480p).

fields.name: Fortnite / UEFN v42.20
fields.value: Epic Games — UEFN v42.20 adds an Unarmed weapon system (punch/shove combat), a Channel API for custom voice/text communication channels, and in-editor UEFN Widget preview/interaction that lets creators test UI animations without starting a play session.

fields.name: Isaac Sim 6.1 (General Availability)
fields.value: NVIDIA — Isaac Sim 6.1 moved from early-developer preview to full general availability, adding a synthetic-data-generation example that uses NVIDIA's "3D Object Reconstruction" framework to turn stereo video of a real object into a textured USD asset.

fields.name: GeForce Game Ready Driver — Path Tracing + DLSS 4.5 Ray Reconstruction in 007 First Light (plus WARDOGS, Aniimo)
fields.value: NVIDIA — NVIDIA shipped a Game Ready Driver adding full path tracing plus DLSS 4.5 Ray Reconstruction to 007 First Light, alongside day-one DLSS 4.5 in newly released games WARDOGS and Aniimo.

fields.name: 007 First Light — Path Tracing & DLSS 4.5 Ray Reconstruction Update
fields.value: NVIDIA (feature shipped in IO Interactive's 007 First Light) — NVIDIA and IO Interactive shipped a free update adding path tracing and DLSS 4.5 Ray Reconstruction to 007 First Light on PC (GeForce RTX), improving lighting, shadows, reflections and global illumination, alongside existing DLSS Super Resolution and Multi Frame Generation, with the game also playable via GeForce NOW.

fields.name: RealityKit Gaussian Splatting support (visionOS 27)
fields.value: Apple — RealityKit in visionOS 27 gained native rendering support for 3D Gaussian Splats via a new GaussianSplatComponent/GaussianSplatResource API, letting apps place photorealistic scanned/reconstructed scenes into spatial experiences.

fields.name: Reality Composer Pro 3 — AI-assisted 3D asset generation ("Reality Composer Pro Assistant")
fields.value: Apple — Reality Composer Pro 3 shipped as a standalone Mac app with a built-in "Reality Composer Pro Assistant" panel that generates 3D objects and materials from natural-language prompts inside the 3D scene editor.

fields.name: RDC 2026 roadmap items — NPC Dynamic Behavior, New Default Movement, Silhouette-preserving Layered Clothing (character animation)
fields.value: Roblox — At RDC 2026, Roblox previewed NPC Dynamic Behavior ("populate games with dynamic NPCs through prompts in Studio," coming late 2026), New Default Movement (motion matching + root motion for avatars, coming early 2027), and Silhouette-preserving Layered Clothing (coming early 2027), per the official devforum recap.

fields.name: Roblox Scene Generator (prompt-to-scene for Build & Studio)
fields.value: Roblox — Roblox announced Scene Generator, which will power prompt-to-scene functionality across both Build and Studio, letting creators turn a text prompt and reference image into a fully functional layout to refine in Studio.
